showcase.title: How it looks
showcase.lead: Illustrations of the modpack panels, not screenshots: the numbers on them are made up.

modpack.title: Three Marks modpack and manager
modpack.lead: Fair-play mods in one click: <hl>marks, battle results and your session</hl> right in the game. The manager moves everything after a patch.

marksPanel.title: “Marks of Excellence”
marksPanel.lead: In battle, your MoE percent and its projection after the battle, with <hl>damage to 65, 85 and 95%</hl> on Alt. In the hangar, a tank card with the trend and battles to the mark.

teamHp.title: “Team HP and score”
teamHp.lead: Total team hit points, the frag score and <hl>a bar per tank</hl> for both teams.

damageLog.title: “Battle log”
damageLog.lead: Your hits with the outcome and the target HP left, assistance and <hl>the hits on you with the shell type</hl>.

crosshair.title: “Crosshairs”
crosshair.lead: Presets for the game's own reticle in arcade and sniper modes, 26 centre marks and <hl>a reload timer with the drum</hl> next to the reticle.

gear.title: “Equipment in battle”
gear.lead: Your equipment and directive icons from the game itself to the left of the shells panel, with <hl>a tooltip on hover</hl>.

hits.title: “Battle log”: hits on you
hits.lead: Who fired, with which shell and how it ended: <hl>damage, no pen or ricochet</hl>.

plus.title: Plus — more analytics
plus.lead: One subscription on top of the free site: <hl>faster stat updates</hl>, deeper analytics and more overlays.

armor.title: 3D armor and comparison
armor.lead: 3D armor models with thickness and angles and <hl>a side-by-side comparison</hl> of vehicles.

builds.title: How to build a tank
builds.lead: Equipment, crew and consumables <hl>with win rates from real battles</hl>.

marks.title: Damage for 65, 85 and 95%
marks.lead: The damage each mark needs <hl>for every vehicle in the game</hl> and a forecast in battles.

ratings.title: How we rate players
ratings.lead: How we calculate WN8, EFF and the Bronya Index and <hl>where the data comes from</hl>.

play.title: Guess the tank and the map
play.lead: Daily «Мир танков» puzzles: <hl>a new tank and a new map</hl> every day.

tournaments.title: Brackets and sign-ups
tournaments.lead: Tournaments run by players: <hl>sign-ups, the bracket and results</hl> on one page.

streamers.title: Overlays for OBS
streamers.lead: A streamer profile, <hl>OBS overlays</hl> and game settings for viewers.
